items.title: Reports emerge that clashes between rival Shia militias, primarily Asa'ib Ahl al-Haq and Saraya al-Salam, have killed at least 200 fighters across Iraq in the past two months.
Iraq: Clashes between rival Shia militias in Baghdad, Basra, and other provinces allegedly kill 200 fighters.
